question: Under what procedural choice may image purification be omitted or performed?
premises: Image purification may be abandoned as an option.
Alternatively it may be caused to be done.
If performed, it follows the stated method.
inference: The officiant may either omit image purification or have it performed according to the prescribed method.
plain_english: One may omit the image purification, or have it performed according to the stated procedure.
